diagnosis.mechanism: Candidate-7 permits an immediately source-local bare entity following an action verb to be classified as ACTION_COUNTERPARTY. The ECOCOMMIT semantic ontology and gold semantics treat that bare grammatical/direct object as the action object, even when the noun denotes a person or organization. Candidate-7 only rejects a local-counterparty classification when a later entity is simultaneously promoted to object, so a lone local entity can remain incorrectly classified as counterpart.
not_supported_as_primary_causes: fact extraction failure in the D003 qualification harness
diagnosis.secondary_observation: One non-action/entity relation was dropped by source-grounding in each D003 attempt, but the qualification failure remains even after excluding that dropped relation because the retained action/entity role is wrong.

candidate8_general_correction_boundary.allowed: Clarify and deterministically validate the general distinction between a bare source-local direct object and an explicitly prepositioned/relational counterparty.
